meta.promptText: Which vitamin C serum should I buy for dark spots and dull skin in India?

response.text:
The Plum 15% Vitamin C Glow Boost Face Serum for Dark Spots features a **stable 15% ethyl ascorbic acid** blend with **Japanese mandarin and Kakadu plum** to tackle stubborn pigmentation and boost natural radiance.

The Foxtale Vitamin C Brightening Face Serum combines **pure 15% L-ascorbic acid and Vitamin E** to deliver an **instant luminosity boost** and target uneven skin texture.

The Pilgrim 10% Vitamin C Face Serum For Daily Brightness 5% Niacinamide pairs **10% Vitamin C with 5% Niacinamide and Korean Cica** to gently brighten skin while **soothing sensitive or reactive skin types**.

The Dot & Key 10% Vitamin C + E 5% Niacinamide Serum utilizes **Sicilian blood orange and Vitamin E** alongside Niacinamide to **fade hyperpigmentation** and smooth texture.

The Garnier Vitamin C + Face Serum for Skin Brightening & Anti-Dark Spots blends **Vitamin C with 2% Niacinamide and Salicylic Acid** for an **accessible, lightweight option** that fights dark spots and acne marks.

The Chemist at Play 10% Vitamin C Brightening Serum offers a **paraben-free, skin-friendly formula** designed to seamlessly fit into daily routines for **hyperpigmentation control**.
